document.name: HOMIO Frontend Execution Plan
document.purpose: Provide a durable, new-chat-safe implementation plan for the complete HOMIO F01-F13 frontend layer, including production modules, routes, state boundaries, REOS bindings, testing, dependency order and definition of done.
document.scope: Production frontend implementation only. Covers F01 through F13, shared frontend engineering modules, prototype migration, REOS integration boundaries, verification and delivery sequence.

authority.frontend_blueprint: REOS_CONTROL_CENTER/architecture/HOMIO_FRONTEND_IMPLEMENTATION_BLUEPRINT.json remains the canonical frontend experience and UX boundary.
authority.this_plan: This document is the canonical frontend coding execution plan and module registry. It does not become a second architecture.
authority.master_architecture: REOS_CONTROL_CENTER/architecture/master/HOMIO_REOS_MASTER_ARCHITECTURE.json remains the canonical overall architecture and business authority.
authority.project_state: REOS_CONTROL_CENTER/data/state.json remains the canonical project-state and execution-state authority.
authority.code: Git branch and implementation workspaces remain the canonical code reference.
authority.acrl: ACRL remains an engineering-time continuity, repository-intelligence, impact-analysis, diagnosis, repair and verification boundary. It is not a frontend runtime dependency.
authority.control_center: Control Center remains authoritative for project execution, verification and approval state.
authority.chat: Chat is communication only and never becomes project state.

implementation_boundary.prototype_role: Visual and interaction reference only. It is not production architecture or canonical business data.
implementation_boundary.approved_runtime: ARCH-038 approved Next.js, React, TypeScript and Node.js stack.

SH01.name: App Shell
SH01.purpose: Global visual and responsive application frame.

SH02.name: Design System
SH02.purpose: Reusable visual primitives and accessibility-safe UI building blocks.

SH03.name: Navigation and Routing
SH03.purpose: Route composition, deep linking and safe context preservation.
SH03.boundary: Authorization remains server-side; these modules only integrate with approved authorization/session capabilities.

SH05.name: REOS Binding Layer
SH05.purpose: Controlled frontend consumption of verified REOS capabilities.
SH05.rule: No adapter may invent a backend contract. Every production binding must reference a verified REOS capability.

SH06.name: Security and Session Integration
SH06.rule: Frontend visibility is never the authorization authority.

SH08.name: Formatting
SH08.rule: Formatting must never change canonical business meaning.

SH09.name: Observability
SH09.purpose: Frontend telemetry and diagnostics without becoming business truth.

F01.name: HOMIO Experience Foundation
F01.goal: Build the production frontend shell, runtime foundation, design system, responsive structure, routing foundation and shared primitives.
done_when: No prototype monolith is carried into production architecture.
No business engine exists in frontend foundation.

F02.name: Global HOMIO Home and Discovery
F02.goal: Create the first useful entry into HOMIO and start a real discovery journey.
REOS_bindings: verified journey continuation capability where available
done_when: First-time user can start a useful search immediately.
Returning user can resume meaningful activity.
No mock business truth is shipped.

F03.name: Search Experience
F03.goal: Provide simple, powerful search while preserving context.
done_when: Useful results appear from verified REOS capability.
No frontend search engine is created.

F04.name: Property Experience
F04.goal: Turn canonical property data into a deep but easy-to-understand decision experience.
done_when: Property information is canonical and current.
Trust/evidence information is presented without becoming frontend authority.

F05.name: Project and Collection Experience
F05.goal: Connect individual property discovery to project-level and collection-level exploration.
done_when: Project and property navigation is seamless.
Project context does not create duplicate inventory ownership.

F06.name: Save, Compare and Return
F06.goal: Help users organize decisions without turning comparison into a database dump.
done_when: Comparison focuses on meaningful decision attributes.
Signed-in state can persist through approved REOS capabilities.
No business ownership or inventory logic is duplicated.

F07.name: My HOMIO Journey
F07.goal: Give users one place to resume meaningful real-estate activity.
F07.rule: My HOMIO aggregates authorized references; it does not become a second business-state database.
done_when: Journey state is traceable to canonical capabilities.
No frontend database becomes the source of truth.

F08.name: Contextual AI
F08.goal: Provide grounded AI assistance inside the user's current real-estate context.
forbidden: AI replacing normal UI where normal UI is safer or simpler
done_when: Grounding/source context is preserved where available.
Unavailable actions are not falsely claimed.

F09.name: Enquiry and Visit
F09.goal: Turn discovery into controlled real-world action.
F09.rule: Frontend initiates authorized actions and displays authoritative results. It does not own lead, visit or communication truth.
done_when: Visit flow handles loading, confirmation, failure and authorization.
Duplicate submissions are prevented where appropriate.

F10.name: Transaction Journey
F10.goal: Expose authorized transaction progress without recreating the transaction engine.
done_when: Authorized transaction state is clearly displayed.
Milestones and next actions are grounded in REOS.

F11.name: Professional SaaS
F11.goal: Provide role-appropriate professional workspaces without creating a second platform architecture.
REOS_bindings: future CORE-008 financial/commission capability where verified
F11.rule: Professional SaaS is a frontend experience layer over existing authorities, never an additional domain engine.
done_when: Professional actions map to verified REOS capabilities.

F12.name: Globalization and International Experience
F12.goal: Prepare HOMIO for multi-market, multilingual and localized real-estate experiences.
forbidden: hardcoded country business rules in presentation components
done_when: Canonical business rules remain in authoritative REOS capabilities.

F13.name: Production Quality and Launch Readiness
F13.goal: Turn the completed experience layer into a measurable production-quality frontend.

f_layer_dependency_graph.parallelization_rule: Only modules with no unresolved shared dependency may be developed in parallel. Shared primitives and REOS binding boundaries must stabilize before dependent slices proceed.

B01.frontend_role: search request/response presentation and context preservation

B03.frontend_role: authorized action initiation and result presentation

frontend_owned_state: temporary optimistic UI where explicitly safe
frontend_state_model.persisted_user_state: Only through approved REOS capabilities or approved frontend persistence for non-authoritative UX preferences.

coding_rules.rule_01: Before creating a module, check whether a shared module or existing REOS capability already solves the requirement.
coding_rules.rule_02: Feature modules own presentation and UX composition, not canonical business logic.
coding_rules.rule_03: Use adapters only for verified capabilities.
coding_rules.rule_04: Do not create generic Manager, Service or Engine classes merely for naming symmetry.
coding_rules.rule_05: Do not mirror CORE-001 through CORE-008 structure inside frontend features.
coding_rules.rule_06: Do not import ACRL into production frontend code.
coding_rules.rule_07: Do not read state.json from the browser.
coding_rules.rule_08: Do not read Master Architecture JSON from the browser.
coding_rules.rule_09: Do not invent API endpoints because a UI needs data.
coding_rules.rule_10: A missing backend capability becomes a clear unavailable/error state, not a fabricated frontend implementation.
coding_rules.rule_11: Preserve user search and journey context wherever practical.
coding_rules.rule_12: Every action requires clear pending, success, failure and unauthorized handling where relevant.
coding_rules.rule_13: Mobile, tablet and desktop are intentional interaction modes.
coding_rules.rule_14: Accessibility is implemented with the feature, not after it.
coding_rules.rule_15: Prototype visual quality may be reused, but prototype architecture is not.

delivery_gates.G01: F01 foundation complete and production build valid.
delivery_gates.G04: F06-F07 decision and journey continuity functional.
delivery_gates.G05: F08-F09 AI and action flows functional.
delivery_gates.G06: F10-F11 transaction and professional surfaces functional.
delivery_gates.G08: F13 full production quality verification complete.

then_check: current F-layer status in this plan
new_chat_bootstrap.continuation_rule: Resume from the first incomplete F-layer gate. Do not restart completed F-layers without evidence of regression.

architecture: Frontend remains subordinate to the Master Architecture.
Frontend does not create a second business architecture.
No duplicate canonical domain engine exists.
implementation: F01-F13 are implemented according to the module registry.
All production routes are intentional and verified.
Prototype is migrated without carrying monolithic architecture into production.
continuity: This plan remains in the repository.
Current F-layer status is maintained here.
New chats can resume from this plan without reconstructing the entire frontend strategy.
